item.title: RCMP officers in Langley, B.C., moved out of the way as driver rams into police car
item.description: VICTORIA — Two RCMP officers in Langley, B.C., had to jump out of the way as a man deliberately used the vehicle he was driving "as a weapon" to ram their cruiser and escape. A statement from police says it happened at around 10:30 a.m.

item.title: Canadian Food Inspection Agency recalls vegan bacon product over undeclared wheat
item.description: OTTAWA — The Canadian Food Inspection Agency has issued a recall for a vegan bacon product sold in Ontario because it contains wheat, which doesn't appear on the list of ingredients.

item.title: Movie Review: In ‘Testament of Ann Lee,’ a blazing Amanda Seyfried can make you believe anything
item.description: Filmmakers Mona Fastvold and Brady Corbet are clearly fascinated by ambition. They're fascinated, too, by dreamers — difficult dreamers, brilliant but demanding people who have plans they must fulfill no matter the personal cost.

item.title: King Charles III picks Westminster Abbey as the site of his Christmas Day broadcast
item.description: LONDON (AP) — King Charles III has chosen Westminster Abbey as the site of his Christmas Day speech on Thursday, reflecting the idea of pilgrimage that is expected to be a theme of the annual address to the United Kingdom and the Commonwealth.

item.title: Virtual reality opens doors for older people to build closer connections in real life
item.description: LOS GATOS, Calif. (AP) — Like many retirement communities , The Terraces serves as a tranquil refuge for a nucleus of older people who no longer can travel to faraway places or engaging in bold adventures.

item.title: A Powerball player in Arkansas has won a $1.817 billion lottery jackpot
item.description: A Powerball player in Arkansas won a $1.817 billion jackpot in Wednesday's Christmas Eve drawing, ending the lottery game’s three-month stretch without a top-prize winner.

item.title: Saudi Arabia calls on Yemen separatists to leave 2 governorates as anti-Houthi coalition strains
